notablePrerequisites: You control at least three lands.
description:
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Naru Meha by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Naru Meha enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Brass's Bounty.
Resolve the copy of Brass's Bounty, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.
